blocks.text: Living in White Rock & Market Overview

parts.t: White Rock is a small seaside city with its own city hall, surrounded by South Surrey. Most households live in apartments: in the 2021 census, 56% of occupied homes were in apartment buildings and 24% were single-detached houses.

blocks.text: White Rock market numbers Benchmarks, sales-to-active ratio & supply

parts.t: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB) reports White Rock and South Surrey as one area. Every month it publishes a benchmark price, median sale price, sales and active listings there for detached homes, townhouses and apartments. Apartments make up most of White Rock's housing, so condo prices drive much of the local market.

blocks.text: What that means for buyers Older strata buildings & hillside lots

parts.t: In 2021, 41.5% of White Rock's homes were in apartment buildings under five storeys, and 39% of all homes were built before 1981. In an older strata building, the depreciation report, reserve fund and history of envelope, roof and plumbing work matter as much as the unit itself. Detached homes are a much smaller share of sales than condos. White Rock has a hillside above the waterfront and a flatter east side, and many detached homes sit on standard city lots with older houses, so lot size, slope and view often matter more than the house itself.

blocks.text: Landmarks, per the City White Rock Pier & Waterfront Promenade

parts.t: is a 470-metre wooden pier first built in 1914/15 and restored in 1977. A December 20, 2018 storm split it in half, and it reopened after repairs in 2019. The promenade runs almost the entire length of the beach, from East Beach to West Beach.

Common Questions · White Rock Real Estate
Is White Rock part of Surrey, or is it its own city?

White Rock is its own city, separate from the City of Surrey, with its own council, bylaws, and property taxes. It shares the Surrey School District (SD36), and FVREB reports its real estate market together with South Surrey.
What kind of homes are in White Rock?
Mostly apartments. In the 2021 census, 56% of occupied homes were apartments in buildings, 24% were single-detached houses and 17% were units in duplexes (including houses with a suite).

In the 2021 census, 39% of White Rock's homes were built before 1981. Review the strata's depreciation report, minutes and reserve fund before removing subjects.
Which school district and high school serve White Rock?

Surrey Schools (SD36) serves both White Rock and Surrey. Most White Rock addresses are in the Semiahmoo Secondary catchment (three of the four addresses checked returned Semiahmoo; one on the east side on Roper Avenue returned Earl Marriott).
